header.title: Maintenance
header.subtitle: Automate hygiene on stale projects without risking uncommitted or local work.

scheduleNote: The schedule runs inside Uncached, so closing to the menu bar keeps it going and Quit stops it. It picks up any run it missed the next time the app opens.

policy.title: Automated Selection Policy
policy.description_one: Reclaim projects untouched for over {{count}} day with at least {{size}} of disposable cache.
policy.description_other: Reclaim projects untouched for over {{count}} days with at least {{size}} of disposable cache.

schedule.title: Unattended Schedule
schedule.subtitle: Runs the policy above without you, and tells you what it removed.

held.disabled: Turned off. Nothing runs unless you press Run Maintenance.
held.notLicensed: Unattended runs need an active licence.
held.noWorkspace: No folders chosen, so there is nothing to maintain.
held.scanInProgress: Waiting for the scan that is open to finish.

schedule.dueNow: Due now. It starts within the next few minutes.
schedule.safety: A scheduled run obeys the same policy and moves to the Trash. It is recorded in Insights as A schedule.
schedule.quitWarning: Closing the window quits Uncached, so this schedule only runs while the window is open. Turn on Keep running in the background in Settings to let it close to the menu bar instead.

selection.emptyHint: All workspace projects are either recently active, below the size floor, or protected.
selection.readyHint: Reclaiming targets moves them reversibly to the Trash.
selection.clean: Your workspace is clean. No dormant projects meet the threshold.
selection.runHint: Moves selected targets to the Trash.
selection.scanToEnable: Scan your workspace to enable one-click maintenance on identified targets.
selection.protected_one: {{count}} project holds uncommitted/unpushed work on this disk (Protected)
selection.protected_other: {{count}} projects hold uncommitted/unpushed work on this disk (Protected)

noFolders.title: No folders chosen yet
noFolders.body: A policy is applied to the projects in the folders you scan. There are none yet.

measuring.body: The selection appears once every project has a weight.

noProjects.title_one: No projects in the folder you chose
noProjects.title_other: No projects in the {{count}} folders you chose
noProjects.body: A project is a directory with a repository or a manifest in it.

indexFailed.title: Your folders could not be read

pro.title: Pro is what runs this policy
pro.body: The selection below is the one a run acts on, and it is the same on every plan. Pro performs the run, repeats it on a schedule without you, and records what each one removed.
